summary: Comprehensive testing of TECNO DIAS budget management system completed. Backend APIs 100% functional, frontend 95% functional with excellent user experience. All core features working including login, dashboard, items management, budget creation with margin calculation, and PDF generation.

Margin alert system works (shows warning when < 20%)
Orçamentos page lists existing budgets with status indicators
Search functionality in items and orçamentos
Navigation between Dashboard, Items, and Orçamentos pages
Modern design with cyan colors (#06b6d4) implemented
All backend API endpoints (16/16 tests passed)
CRUD operations for items and orçamentos
